description: We are Huiñaypaq Ccanhuan (“Always With You”), a team of Peruvian students using science and technology to improve healthcare. Through ASTRA, we aim to monitor astronauts’ vital signs and physiological patterns throughout their missions, helping identify changes and protect their well-being. Inspired by healthcare inequalities in Peru, we believe innovation must go beyond recognizing problems: it must help address them. Our mission is to use technology to care for people, wherever they are.
